reviews.review:
The souls like genre is a hard one, there are so many elements and intricacy of level design done extremely well that make a Fromsoft game. There hasn't been anyone that has matched them and very few have come even close to a decent facsimile.
This game is made with a much lower budget but if you persist you will realise the obvious love of those style games the developer has. 
What it does do it try a hybrid of gunplay with souls style combat, sometimes it's clunky as hell and unfair and you will rage. Sniper rifles with a decent melee weapon are almost essential. 
There is some fun level design and enough variety in the locations and enemies that kept me interested enough to finish the game.
Yes it is hard and the teleporting sniper/shotgun arseholes are not fun, but the game does give you enough tools to cope if you persist.
For the price it is well worth a look if you like the soulslike genre of games.
